Installed via TaskManager_Jump from ov03_02258764 (asm/overlay_03.s:9257), which sets env state to 0x18 right after. Two-case if/else-if on env->state: 0x18 -> env->state = sub_02092B40(fieldSystem, env); 0x19 -> sub_02092B7C(taskManager). Always returns FALSE (mov r0,#0). Only export of this file (.inc .public lists sub_02092B04 only) -> sub_02092B40/sub_02092B7C should be static. Compare-chain (beq/beq/b) suggests if/else-if, not switch.

functions.notes: Returns 0x18 while FieldSystem_ApplicationIsRunning(fieldSystem) is TRUE (wait), else saves bag state, frees BagView, FieldSystem_LoadFieldOverlay, returns 0x19. Return is strb'd into state byte so u8 or int return both plausible — pick int/u32 if u8 causes extra narrowing. 0x2A0 built via mov #0x2a; lsl #4 (large-offset idiom).

notes: Tiny 3-function thumb file (~0xB4 bytes, 0x02092B04-0x02092BB8), no .rodata/.data/.bss, no save_arrays.c involvement.
